{{Quote|Raider Squadron is composed of the best pilots in the galaxy flying very advanced starfighters.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="TCW12">[[The Clone Wars 12|''The Clone Wars'' 12]]</ref>}}
'''Tofen's Raiders''', also known as '''Raider Squadron''', was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] under the command of [[Tofen Vane/Legends|Tofen Vane]]. He led the group in his battle against the naval forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

They were based at [[Harko Station]] in the [[Veil Nebula/Legends|Veil Nebula]] and composed entirely of [[Valahari]] pilots.
